live_tv.title: Live TV
live_tv.description: Watch an HDHomeRun’s channels live on your screens.

data_description.host: The tuner’s IP address on your network.
data_description.guide_url: Optional. An XMLTV file that says what is on each channel.

live_tv_channels.title: Channels
live_tv_channels.description: Pick the channels to show. You can add or remove channels later under Configure.

error.live_tv_cannot_connect: Could not reach an HDHomeRun at that address.
error.live_tv_no_channels: The tuner has no channels. Run a channel scan on it first.
error.live_tv_guide_failed: Could not read a guide at that address.

live_tv_options.title: Live TV
live_tv_options.description: Add or remove channels, change the picture quality, or set the guide.

data_description.guide_url: Optional. An XMLTV file that says what is on each channel. Leave it empty for no guide.

abort.live_tv_cannot_connect: Could not reach the HDHomeRun. Check that it is on and at the same address.
